blocks.text: Jab diye gaye monomer(s) mein C=C bond ho to addition polymerisation hogi. Misalein: ethene, propene aur phenyl ethene (styrene). Addition polymerisation se zyada tar homopolymers bante hain, yani aik hi qism ke monomer se bane polymers. Lekin kabhi double bond wale do mukhtalif monomers ko saath polymerise kiya jata hai; is ko copolymerisation kehte hain. Is ki misal ethene aur propenoic acid (H₂C=CH-COOH) ka copolymer hai.

blocks.alt: C=C wale chaar monomers: CH2=CH2 (ethene), CH2=CHCH3 (propene), CH2=CHC6H5 (phenylethene, styrene) aur CH2=CHCOOH (propenoic acid, ethene ke saath copolymer).

blocks.prompt: Homopolymer aur copolymer mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Homopolymer aik hi qism ke monomer se banta hai; copolymer do (ya zyada) mukhtalif monomers se banta hai.
